bottom_line.rotation_gauge_condition: The circular-mean weights are physical-state-derived, the weighted resultant is nonzero, and alternate teacher phases differ only by a constant S1 rotation.

assumptions.name: primitive_embedded_orbit
assumptions.statement: The complete masked delay-state orbit is an embedded S1 with trivial rotational stabilizer, and one human repetition is assumed to equal one forward traversal.

assumptions.name: teacher_topology
assumptions.statement: For fixed content, the memoryless teacher restricted to the orbit is an orientation-preserving degree-one homeomorphism with no decoder or static-code bypass.

assumptions.name: cross_view_phase_stability
assumptions.statement: Sampling, cycle count, or static-code changes alter corresponding teacher phases by at most a constant rotation, not a nonlinear circle homeomorphism.

assumptions.name: projection_validity
assumptions.statement: The projection is fixed independently of the teacher, valid on fixed mask support, and invariant at corresponding physical states under all allowed warps.

assumptions.name: unique_landmark
assumptions.statement: The projected score has one isolated global maximum per primitive orbit; repeated occurrences across cycles are allowed, but separated within-cycle maxima are not.

assumptions.name: complete_support
assumptions.statement: At least one uninterrupted complete orbit traversal is observed.

assumptions.name: sampling_no_alias
assumptions.statement: Each valid adjacent interval contains less than one quarter of a true traversal and cannot hide an integer number of cycles.

assumptions.name: positive_orientation
assumptions.statement: Warps preserve orientation; pauses have constant phase; time reversal is outside the contract.

assumptions.name: origin_concentration
assumptions.statement: Circular concentration, landmark uniqueness, and cross-cycle stability satisfy every preregistered threshold.

theorem.origin_formula: For each complete traversal j, c_j = integral exp(kappa(s-smax_j)) z dA / integral exp(kappa(s-smax_j)) dA; C = mean_j c_j; o = C/|C|; z_canonical = z conjugate(o).
theorem.rotation_equivariance: If z'=exp(i beta)z, then C'=exp(i beta)C, o'=exp(i beta)o, and z'_canonical=z_canonical.
theorem.warp_invariance: The Riemann-Stieltjes integral with respect to unwrapped phase traversal measure dA is invariant to orientation-preserving time reparameterization.
theorem.repetition_invariance: Equal per-complete-cycle normalization makes identical repeated cycles contribute identical c_j values; adding an identical cycle does not move o.
theorem.crossing_result: A positive degree-one traversal has exactly one half-open integer crossing on every complete orbit traversal.
theorem.decoder_result: Exactly one connected supra-0.5 component per target, separated by sub-0.5 valleys with no extras, is sufficient for the single connected-component decoder to return the event count.
theorem.limitation: A finite-kappa circular mean is not invariant to a general orientation-preserving nonlinear reparameterization of S1.

steps: Collapse adjacent duplicate source clocks before delay-state construction.
Abstain on conflicting or noncontiguous duplicate clocks.
Split into maximal valid segments and never unwrap or connect components across gaps.

algorithm.formula: s_t = sum_d m_td a_d (y_td-mu_d)/sigma_d / (sqrt(sum_d m_td a_d^2)+epsilon_p)
algorithm.guard: All nonzero projection support must be observed and warp-invariant; raw velocity magnitude and fixed-frame lags require a passing correspondence test.

steps: Normalize z with an epsilon-protected L2 norm.
Partition cumulative progress into complete intervals [j,j+1].
Split boundary edges deterministically and exclude trailing partial intervals.

algorithm.formula: ell_b=log(lambda_b)+kappa(s_b-smax_j); c_j=sum exp(ell_b-L_j)z_b/sum exp(ell_b-L_j); C=mean_j c_j; o=C/|C|
steps: Use phase-length quadrature rather than sample counts.
Subtract the largest log weight before exponentiation.
Use pairwise or compensated sums and equal per-cycle normalization.

algorithm.formula: z_canonical=z*conjugate(o); e_t=floor(S_tau(A_t+1))-floor(S_tau(A_t)) with A_t+1=A_t+delta_t and tau=1e-7 cycles
guards: Abstain on backward seam crossing or multiple crossing.
Require pulse equality for tau in {1e-8,1e-7,1e-6}.

steps: Threshold once at 0.5 and count connected components once per identity.
Choose the lower-index midpoint of a maximal plateau.
Do not use NMS, a learned distance, or an integral fallback.

counterexamples: Uniform sample-weighted means move when one side of the landmark is oversampled.
Velocity magnitude and fixed-frame delay lags are clock-blind but warp-variant.
Antipodal or near-tied projection maxima make the origin undefined or unstable.
A general orientation-preserving phase homeomorphism preserves degree and reconstruction but changes a finite-width mean seam.
A self-intersection in the complete masked delay state is not distinguishable by a memoryless teacher.
Observable q-fold symmetry can produce q primitive orbit traversals per human-labelled repetition.
A partial observed arc does not reveal the unseen global projection maximum or boundary convention.
A pause and one or more hidden complete cycles can have identical sampled endpoints and modulo phase.
Missing gaps can hide an arbitrary number of repetitions.
Time reversal changes increment sign and is not handled by the positive crossing rule.
Pause entry and exit can create off-orbit delay-state transients.
Static codes can induce nonlinear phase deformations rather than constant rotations.
Disjoint window pulses can average below threshold after NOLA.
Broad window responses can bridge an inter-event valley after NOLA.
Changing masks can create a mask-driven rather than pose-driven landmark.
kill_conditions: Nontrivial orbit symmetry or unresolved complete-delay-state collision.
Origin concentration or warp/repetition invariance below threshold.
Unsupported clock gaps or an indefensible no-hidden-cycle acquisition assumption.
Backward seam crossing, time reversal, or pause transient.
Any split, merge, or miss in the held-out threshold-0.5 pulse gate.
Teacher-only natural mismatch between the observable primitive orbit and evaluator repetition unit.
unidentifiable_human_conventions: Whether left and right subcycles count separately.
Whether multiple primitive orbit traversals form one named action.
Whether a pause terminates, suspends, or restarts a repetition.
How mirrored or symmetric states are grouped.

verdict.defensible_claim: For a gap-free, sufficiently sampled, forward traversal of an identifiable primitive masked-delay-state orbit with a unique frozen pose landmark, the system emits one final threshold-0.5 connected component per observed orbit traversal after NOLA.
verdict.benchmark_totality_warning: If the benchmark requires a count for every finite, gappy, possibly partial track, the strict theorem does not cover the benchmark.
verdict.pilot_condition: Report abstention and coverage, validate teacher-only counts without tuning, and treat any human-convention mismatch as terminal.
